channel.title: CoffeeLovesTea Video Games
channel.description: News from the Coffeehouse Arcade — Espresso the red panda runs the video games at CoffeeLovesTea. Updates, announcements, and spotlights for Coffeehouse Rush, Bean Catch, Song Memory Match, and Field Goal Kick. All four games are free to play.

item.title: Announcement: CoffeeLovesTea games are live on Playgama's test sandbox
item.description: All four CoffeeLovesTea games passed Playgama's build check and are published in their test sandbox — open it, play all four, and share it around. The games are free, as always.

item.title: Update: gameplay screenshots added on itch.io
item.description: Each CoffeeLovesTea game on itch.io now shows a real gameplay screenshot, so you can peek inside Coffeehouse Rush, Bean Catch, Song Memory Match, and Field Goal Kick before you play. All free.

item.title: Announcement: find our games on itch.io, Game Jolt, and SlowDen
item.description: The Coffeehouse Arcade is out in the world — all four games are live and free on itch.io, Game Jolt, and SlowDen. Pick your favorite corner of the internet and come play.

item.title: Game spotlight: Coffeehouse Rush
item.description: Pour coffee and keep the coffeehouse moving in Coffeehouse Rush — the first game in the Coffeehouse Arcade, free to play right on your phone. Espresso runs the arcade.

item.title: Game spotlight: Bean Catch
item.description: Catch the falling beans in Bean Catch — a quick, cozy arcade game in the Coffeehouse Arcade, free to play right on your phone. Espresso runs the arcade.

item.title: Game spotlight: Song Memory Match
item.description: Match the songs in Song Memory Match — a memory game built around the CoffeeLovesTea radio station, free to play right on your phone. Espresso runs the arcade.

item.title: Game spotlight: Field Goal Kick
item.description: Kick a field goal in Field Goal Kick — our football-season game in the Coffeehouse Arcade, free to play right on your phone. Espresso runs the arcade.
